outcomes.title: Government Investment and Accountable Delivery
outcomes.desc: Governments uphold their human rights obligations, assess and address discriminatory impacts, invest in community priorities, and deliver measurable improvements through coordinated action and transparent accountability.

outcomes.title: Community Wealth and Inclusive Local Economies
outcomes.desc: Residents and community organizations build and retain economic assets, access decent jobs and affordable commercial opportunities, and share equitably in the benefits of investment.

outcomes.title: Right to Remain and Return
outcomes.desc: Existing residents and businesses are protected from displacement and have meaningful, affordable opportunities to remain or return as their neighbourhood changes.

outcomes.title: Community Decision-Making and Reparative Justice
outcomes.desc: Residents and community organizations exercise meaningful authority over planning and implementation; Indigenous rights and governance are respected, and public institutions acknowledge and remedy harms caused by past decisions.

outcomes.title: Belonging and Cultural Continuity
outcomes.desc: Residents experience belonging, see their histories and contributions recognized, and sustain the cultural practices, institutions and community relationships that connect them to place.

outcomes.title: Adequate Standard of Living and Wellbeing
outcomes.desc: Residents have access to affordable and appropriate housing, essential services, safe mobility and healthy, climate-resilient living conditions, including support for multigenerational households, older adults and people experiencing homelessness.

aggregation: each completed response contributes once; provisional averages available from first completion
explicitChoice: Ten highest topics are suggested from ranked themes and outcomes; participants can pin other topics to the highest ten, automatically displacing the lowest-ranked unpinned suggestion, and can move any highest topic to the middle, replacing it with the next eligible suggestion; participants select four lowest from the middle, leaving nineteen in the middle.
outcomeAssignmentPolicy: Each topic belongs to exactly one primary outcome. Outcomes each cover at least two planning themes; suggestions combine the participant's theme rank with the rank of the topic's single primary outcome. Human rights and Indigenous rights are assessed across outcomes as requirements, not as a separately ranked outcome.
humanRightsLens: All six outcomes must respect applicable housing and human rights obligations, confront anti-Black and anti-Indigenous racism and other forms of systemic discrimination, address age- and disability-related barriers, and respect distinct Indigenous rights, treaties and governance. Topic-level human rights obligations are explicitly assessed through A-8 and R-3; this cross-cutting lens does not create additional score points or alter the documentary ratings.
suggestionFormula: Score = 100 * (0.6 * (theme rank points - 4) / 6 + 0.4 * (outcome rank points - 1) / 5). Theme ranks 1–7 have points 10–4; outcome ranks 1–6 have points 6–1. Only the provisional top-ten suggestion ranking is affected; final participant-selected topic weights remain 60% highest ten, 37% middle nineteen, and 3% lowest four.
